accepted_conclusion: The pinned upstream APIs do not expose complete caller-declared allocation/work enforcement for a small in-process wrapper. rqrr decode_to writer is a partial output property only. No complete conservative all-input admission bound is established.
technical_basis: Quircs eager identify finishes threshold/scan/grouping before returning CodeIter; internal flood Vec and geometric work have no caller budget. Count guards/output8896 are separate library bounds.

Rqrr private prepare module does not reexport ImageBuffer; public no-img raw constructors allocate library storage. Pair ranking/sort, cache/repaint/flood and temporary cloned image state are not covered by output writer limits.
Rqrr decode_to streams fallible Write after raw/ECC normal-or-mirrored processing; partial output requires discard on every error. It does not cap preceding detection or ECC.
Dimension preflight and checked products are input preconditions, not complete projective arithmetic/allocator/live-state/work proofs.
